_note: The kinds table: one per kind, read by the lock and by gate.py. cpu: a whole number of cpu slots 1..the layout agent_cap, set only by gate.py --measure and a reviewed commit; a run may ask for fewer (--cores), never more. medium (medium_cores) and heavy (the half cap, or every core inside an owner whole hold) stay as aliases. gpu: 0 (none) or pool (the whole gpu pool; share true lets --gpu-share training take one gpu slot). warn_min: a WARNING past this, never a kill; with no --expect it is also a run's expected time until its repo, kind and mode have history_min_runs finished runs (quick-test, a run of only the touched tests: 5, so its first runs expect 300 s and can backfill).mem_mb (optional): a run's memory need in MB until its repo, kind and mode have 5 finished runs, when the p90 of their peak commit replaces it; without one, the lock's default need (Settings mem_default_mb). A run starts only when the machine's commit charge plus its need fits under the commit limit less the reserve (Settings mem_reserve_mb). mem_since (optional, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC): history counts only from that date (graph-build: 9999-12-31, none yet, until a game repository's --no-daemon change lands; then the date of its first run under it). Sizes change only by a PM-reviewed commit. land-<kind>: what a landing's merged gate books in place of its "gate".kind <kind> (kitlib.gate.land; land-test: 4 cores by the owner's call, no measurement). aliases: a retired name and the kind it books now (generic names); a caller passing one still books, and a record written under one compares equal to the kind.

engine-test.why: the generic name for a repository's test run

engine-run.why: the generic name for a run of the application (a game engine, a live client)
